scripts.test:admin: pnpm build && mocha --grep "REB-13 admin authoring and round-trip suite"
scripts.test:pages: pnpm build && mocha --grep "REB-12 public site pages"
scripts.test:templates: pnpm build && mocha --grep "REB-12 template-by-template public site coverage"
scripts.test:headed: cross-env HEADLESS=false pnpm build && cross-env HEADLESS=false mocha
scripts.test:debug: cross-env HEADLESS=false SLOWMO=250 pnpm build && cross-env HEADLESS=false SLOWMO=250 mocha --grep @smoke
scripts.test:ci: cross-env CI=true pnpm build && cross-env CI=true mocha --reporter mocha-junit-reporter --reporter-options mochaFile=./reports/junit/selenium-results.xml
